name: delegated-arc-watch
description: Delegated-arc watch — reports a subagent transcript that stopped growing or disappeared

name: service-status-watch
description: Anthropic service-status watch — reports when the Claude API/Claude Code goes degraded or recovers, and flags other monitors to fall silent meanwhile

name: quota-watch
description: Account quota watch — reports five-hour/seven-day usage crossing a threshold and window resets, so a long delegated arc gets a wake-up before hitting the wall

name: autonomy-watch
description: Autonomy watch — wakes a mandated session that still has queued work, nothing in flight, and no new turn for long enough

name: wake-floor
description: Wake floor — periodically hands a turn back to a mandated session based only on elapsed time
